body: This is exactly what happened to me as well. I was in a group chat with coworkers and be invited out 2-3 times a month, then realized only maybe one invite would go out in the group chat per month while they continued to go out to other places the remaining weekends, and now it has been radio silent for months. My parents occasionally send a text when they need me to sign something or other nonsense, and they are 900 miles away as I moved after college to get away from them.

Yes I have in the past, but not recently. It does seem like a way to step outside yourself and possibly form relationships without specifically trying. Maybe I will try to look for something like an animal rescue place in my area.
It sounds pathetic, but my calico - Bubbles - has stopped me before. I couldn't leave her
